thread.title: Top Growth Stocks: Keysight Tech, Methanex Break Out, Hit New Highs

author: ALISSA CORAM
title: Top Growth Stocks: Keysight Tech, Methanex Break Out, Hit New Highs
text:
Keysight Technologies ( KEYS ) and Methanex ( MEOH ) may not have the same brand recognition as Apple ( AAPL ) or Walt Disney ( DIS ), but both top growth stocks have been strong performers this year. The two midcap stocks are also breaking out to new highs in the stock market today .
X Keysight and Methanex saw accelerating earnings growth last quarter, a hallmark trait of top growth stocks. Methanex earns an IBD Composite Rating of 89 out of 99, meaning its shares outperform 89% of all stocks in the market on key fundamental and technical metrics. Meanwhile, Keysight's stock earns an 84 rating.
Top growth stocks typically have high composite ratings as they launch big runs. In addition to earnings and sales growth, the Composite Rating includes metrics like profit margins, return on equity and relative price performance.
Keysight Stock Breakout Keysight stock jumped more than 16% Wednesday morning, easily surpassing a flat base buy point of 62.51 in heavy volume. The breakaway gap meant that one who has conviction in the stock could buy at or near the stock's open price of 69.51. However, it has since dropped a little more than 7% below that alternative entry point.
It's important to keep losses small in every stock investment, ideally at no more than 7% to 8%. This is the golden rule of investing .
Even after the stock has pared that gain by half, the relative strength line is still hitting new high ground.
The RS line measures price performance vs. the S&P 500, meaning Keysight stock is showing outperformance. Seeing the RS line at a new high on a breakout is bullish.
While shares were initially well extended from the proper 5% buy range in intraday trade, the stock is now trading about 4% above the flat base entry. Keysight stock has gained some 56% since the start of the year.
Methanex And A Stock Breakout Methanex, which is up 23% in 2018, is staging a breakout above a 74.27 correct buy point from a flat base . The 3% gain is coming in lighter-than-average volume. Strong volume on a breakout indicates support from institutional investors, and it's key to follow the big money when investing.
Both Methanex and Keysight have formed multiple bases along their recent runs, giving investors multiple opportunities to get in.
Top Growth Stocks And Average Volume One reason why these stocks might be considered "hidden gems" is that their average daily trading volume is on the lighter end of the spectrum. Investors may want to keep in mind the added risk that can come with thinly traded, or illiquid, stocks. Methanex trades on average 423,000 shares each day. That's still a decent amount.
Plus, institutional sponsorship is growing.
Total mutual funds and hedge funds owning shares in Methanex have grown to 719 funds at the end of the second quarter, up from 624 in the year-ago period.
Keysight has an even bigger average turnover (864,000 shares) and the average dollar turnover of roughly $55 million is substantial.
